This page tracks the character creation process for **AshE** (**Takahashi Étaín & Aisling**)—with her twin **Aisling** modeled as Étaín's post-chargen **Music Ally Sprite**—built using the Point Buy system (*Sixth World Companion*, pp. 28–30) and the Digital Intelligence and Codesmithing rules (*Hack & Slash*, pp. 114–128).

> **Lab Template Relationship:** Étaín (+ Aisling) is the **Spark Purist Twin Pair** fork of the [Takahashi Second-Generation Sparks Template](../sparks_template.md). Unlike Ouro, Étaín sides with Reiko in keeping her **Spark whole (6.00)**—forgoing all codemods to preserve **Resonance 6** on Day 1 and dedicating her resources to twin **Shiawase Silverstar** anthroform bodies for herself and Aisling (`Avail 4`, `+0` Heat per *DC* p. 127, saving `89,000¥` DIY across both hulls at endgame).

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| include: false
# Initial stats
Firewall = 0
Data_Processing = 0
Sleaze = 0
Attack = 0
Willpower = 0
Logic = 0
Intuition = 0
Charisma = 0
Resonance = 0
Edge = 0
Spark = 6.0

Tasking = 0
Electronics = 0
Cracking = 0

Karma = 0
Nuyen = 0
Contact_Points = 0
Character_Points = 0

def inc(name, amount=1):
    globals()[name] += amount
    op = "+=" if amount >= 0 else "-="
    return f"{name} {op} {abs(amount)}"

def assign(name, value):
    globals()[name] = value
    return f"{name} = {value}"

def inc_many(*pairs):
    res = []
    for name, amount in pairs:
        globals()[name] += amount
        op = "+=" if amount >= 0 else "-="
        res.append(f"{name} {op} {abs(amount)}")
    return ", ".join(res)

from sr6core.character.ledger import complex_form, echo, language, modifier, knowledge_skill
```

Shadowrunners are built with **100 Character Points (CP)** and gain **50 points of customization Karma** (*6WC*, p. 28).

* `{python} assign('Character_Points', 100)`
* `{python} assign('Karma', 50)`

---

## 1. Choose Your Metatype/Metavariant

* **Metatype**: **AI / Pilot AI** (*Hack & Slash*, p. 114) `{python} inc('Karma', 0)`
* **Digital Intelligence Trait**: Living Persona Matrix attributes replace physical attributes (*Hack & Slash*, pp. 114–120):
  * Body $\rightarrow$ **Firewall** (Base 1, Racial Max 6)
  * Agility $\rightarrow$ **Data Processing** (Base 1, Racial Max 7)
  * Reaction $\rightarrow$ **Sleaze** (Base 1, Racial Max 6)
  * Strength $\rightarrow$ **Attack** (Base 1, Racial Max 7)
* **Mental Attribute Maxima**:
  * Willpower: Base 1, Racial Max 6
  * Logic: Base 1, Racial Max 5
  * Intuition: Base 1, Racial Max 8
  * Charisma: Base 1, Racial Max 5
* **Inherent Virtual Life Form Qualities** (*Hack & Slash*, p. 114):
  * **Pilot Origins (Rating 1)**: Inherent metatype trait (kept at baseline R1 so it does not consume a chargen quality slot).
  * **Sensor Upgrade**: Inherent metatype trait enhancing sensory processing telemetry.

---

## 2. Choose Mundane, Awakened, or Emerged

* **Emerged (Technomancer)**: `{python} inc('Character_Points', -10)`
* Technomancers start with `{python} assign('Resonance', 1)`.
* Unlocks access to complex forms (up to $\text{Resonance} \times 2 = 12$), purchasable at 2 CP or 5 Karma each (*6WC*, p. 29).

---

## 3. Purchase Special / Metatype Adjustment Points with CP

* All characters start with 1 Edge: `{python} inc('Edge', 1)`
* All characters start with 1 metatype adjustment point for free: `{python} inc('Resonance', 1)` (Resonance 1 $\rightarrow$ 2)
* Purchase 9 additional adjustment points at 4 CP each (*6WC*, p. 29):
  * 5 points to Edge: `{python} inc('Edge', 5)` : `{python} inc('Character_Points', -20)` (Edge 1 $\rightarrow$ 6; racial max, saves **55 Karma** post-chargen)
  * 4 points to Resonance: `{python} inc('Resonance', 4)` : `{python} inc('Character_Points', -16)` (Resonance 2 $\rightarrow$ 6, unreduced)
* Total CP spent on Special Adjustments: **36 CP** (9 points $\times$ 4 CP; $\le 12$-point *6WC* cap).

---

## 4. Purchase Attributes with CP

All Matrix and mental attributes start at minimum 1:

* `{python} assign('Firewall', 1)` (Body equivalent)
* `{python} assign('Data_Processing', 1)` (Agility equivalent)
* `{python} assign('Sleaze', 1)` (Reaction equivalent)
* `{python} assign('Attack', 1)` (Strength equivalent)
* `{python} assign('Willpower', 1)`
* `{python} assign('Logic', 1)`
* `{python} assign('Intuition', 1)`
* `{python} assign('Charisma', 1)`

All characters receive 4 attribute points for free (*6WC*, p. 29):
* `{python} inc('Data_Processing', 4)` (Data Processing 1 $\rightarrow$ 5)

Purchase 20 additional attribute points for 2 CP each (20 points max, 40 CP):
* `{python} inc('Firewall', 4)` : `{python} inc('Character_Points', -8)` (Firewall 1 $\rightarrow$ 5)
* `{python} inc('Data_Processing', 2)` : `{python} inc('Character_Points', -4)` (Data Processing 5 $\rightarrow$ 7)
* `{python} inc('Willpower', 4)` : `{python} inc('Character_Points', -8)` (Willpower 1 $\rightarrow$ 5)
* `{python} inc('Logic', 3)` : `{python} inc('Character_Points', -6)` (Logic 1 $\rightarrow$ 4; Pilot AI cap is 5)
* `{python} inc('Intuition', 4)` : `{python} inc('Character_Points', -8)` (Intuition 1 $\rightarrow$ 5; Pilot AI cap is 8)
* `{python} inc('Charisma', 3)` : `{python} inc('Character_Points', -6)` (Charisma 1 $\rightarrow$ 4; Pilot AI cap is 5; grants 24 Contact Points)

Total CP spent on Attributes: **40 CP** (20 points $\times$ 2 CP).

::: {.callout-tip title="Attribute Legality Verification"}
* **Racial Caps**: Firewall 5 / 6, Data Processing 7 / 7, Sleaze 1 / 6, Attack 1 / 7, Willpower 5 / 6, Logic 4 / 5, Intuition 5 / 8, Charisma 4 / 5.
* **Chargen Max Constraint**: Only **one** attribute (**Data Processing 7**) is at its racial maximum during chargen (*SR6 CRB* p. 66 compliant).
:::

## 5. Purchase Skills with CP

Per *Hack & Slash* ("Actions in the Foundation", p. 141; "Operating in the Realms", p. 158), all Digital Intelligences share the foundational skills of daily Matrix life (`Electronics`, `Cracking`). Under *6WC* p. 29 and *CRB* p. 65, only **one** skill may start at the chargen maximum of Rating 6 without *Aptitude*: Étaín maxes **Electronics 6** (meeting the Level 6 Ally Sprite source-code threshold and *Infusion* tests), leaving **Cracking 5** and **Tasking 5**.

All characters start with 12 skill points for free (*6WC*, p. 29):
* `{python} inc('Electronics', 6)` (Base 0 $\rightarrow$ 6)
* `{python} inc('Cracking', 5)` (Base 0 $\rightarrow$ 5)
* `{python} inc('Tasking', 1)` (Base 0 $\rightarrow$ 1)

Additional skill points cost 2 CP each:
* `{python} inc('Tasking', 4)` : `{python} inc('Character_Points', -8)` (Tasking 1 $\rightarrow$ 5)

Total CP spent on Skills: **8 CP** (4 points $\times$ 2 CP).

---

## 11. Submersion, MUG Affiliation, Foci, and Complex Forms

### Matrix User Group (MUG): River People

* **River People (Connection 7 / Loyalty 8)** Membership Fee (*SRMG v2.4*, pp. 59–60): `{python} inc('Karma', -6)`
* Enables the MUG Decay Protocol (-8K discount at Loyalty 8, decaying to the -4K Loyalty 4 floor).

### Submersion & Echoes (Grades 1 & 2 @ Loyalty 8 Discount)

Prioritizing Day-1 combat/action capability over dormant sprite-birthing echoes puts **Override** and **Overclocking** active from Session 1, while `New Sprite Type` and `Sprite Conduit` unlock on SRMs #1–2 right as Karma arrives to bond Aisling:

* **Submersion Grade 1**: $10 + 1 - 8 = \mathbf{3\text{ Karma}}$ `{python} inc('Karma', -3)` `{python} echo('Resonance Power: Override')`
  * **Echo: Resonance Power — Override** (*Hack & Slash*, p. 68 / *CRB*, p. 194): Uses `Resonance` (6, or 10 w/ Focus) as the drone's Pilot rating and shifts weapon attacks onto **`Targeting + Sensor`**, bypassing `Logic 4` from Day 1.
* **Submersion Grade 2**: $10 + 2 - 8 = \mathbf{4\text{ Karma}}$ `{python} inc('Karma', -4)` `{python} echo('Overclocking')`
  * **Echo: Overclocking** (*CRB*, p. 195): `+1` Minor Action & **+1D6 Initiative** in hot-sim VR (**5D6** / 2 Major Actions per turn from Day 1), and pre-qualifies Étaín to encode `Overclocking` onto Aisling.

### Focus Bonding

* **Resonance Focus (Rating 4)**: `{python} inc('Karma', -4)`
  * `{python} modifier("Resonance Focus", "attribute:resonance", 4, type="focus", rule_anchor="rules/rules_matrix.html#foci", notes="+4 dice to tests using RES")`
  * Elevates Étaín's effective Resonance dice pool from 6 to **10**.

### Complex Forms (Karma Purchases)

Because Complex Forms (`5K`), Specializations (`5K`), and Focus bonding (`4K`) cost the **exact same Karma post-chargen** (unlike Qualities at 2×, Attributes, or Submersions), chargen Karma prioritizes Qualities and Submersions first, while the remaining customization Karma covers Day-1 operational Complex Forms and the Resonance Focus (deferring *Electronics Spec: Complex Forms* and *Infusion* until Mission 1 / Submersion 4):

* **Attack Attribution** (*Hack & Slash*, pp. 62–63): `{python} inc('Karma', -5)` `{python} complex_form('Attack Attribution', fading='Hits', duration='Sustained', target='Persona', notes='Target gains Attack attribute equal to hits on Electronics + RES test.')`
* **Sleaze Attribution** (*Hack & Slash*, pp. 66–67): `{python} inc('Karma', -5)` `{python} complex_form('Sleaze Attribution', fading='Hits', duration='Sustained', target='Persona', notes='Target gains Sleaze attribute equal to hits on Electronics + RES test.')`
* **Hyperthreading** (*Hack & Slash*, p. 131): `{python} inc('Karma', -5)` `{python} complex_form('Hyperthreading', fading=3, duration='Immediate', target='Persona', notes='Allows simultaneous threading and sustaining of multiple complex forms sharing target and level.')`
* **Resonance Wires** (*Hack & Slash*, p. 66): `{python} inc('Karma', -5)` `{python} complex_form('Resonance Wires', fading=2, duration='Sustained', target='Device/Persona', notes='Establishes remote direct connection via line of sight; pairs with Jack Jockey.')`

## Post-Chargen Progression: Three-Tracker Upgrade Protocol

Because post-chargen advancement is gated by **three independent finite resources**—**Major Downtime Actions** (Mainline SRMs only), **Karma** (SRMs + CMPs + *Work for the People*), and **Nuyen** (DIY 50% hardware & software)—progression is tracked in three parallel queues. Whenever an upgrade opportunity opens, execute in strict priority order: **1) Submersions** $\rightarrow$ **2) Karma Queue** $\rightarrow$ **3) Nuyen / Hardware Queue**.

---

### Tracker 1: Major Downtime Action Queue (Submersion Echoes)

*Each Submersion consumes **1 Major Action** (Mainline SRMs only) and uses the **River People MUG Decay Protocol** (2 missions per month: Loyalty `8 -> 7 -> 6 -> 5 -> 4`). Remember: Submersion Grade cannot exceed natural **Resonance**.*

| Grade | Target Echo | Source / Prereq | Cost | Cadence / Gate | Tactical Role |
| :---: | :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| **1–2** | *Resonance Power: Override*, *Overclocking* | *H&S* p. 68 / *CRB* pp. 194–195 | `3K + 4K` | **Chargen** | **Online Day 1:** `Override` (`20d6` Pilot, `Targeting + Sensor`) & **5D6** Hot-Sim VR Initiative (2 Major Actions/turn). |
| **3** | **New Sprite Type** | *H&S* p. 72 | **5K*** | **SRM #1** *(M1, L8)* | Unlocks compiling & registering **Music Sprites** (for Aisling). |
| **4** | **Sprite Conduit** | *H&S* pp. 77–78 | **6K*** | **SRM #2** *(M1, L8)* | Unlocks Step 3 Permanent Registration & Step 4 Ally Sprite bonding—arrives right as Karma hits `24K` for Aisling! *(End M1: L8 $\rightarrow$ L7.)* |
| **5** | **Living Network** | *CRB* p. 195 | **8K*** | **SRM #3** *(M2, L7)* | PAN master for twin Silverstars; unlocks **2nd Sourceror slot** (`5/2=2`), sustaining hyperthreaded *Enlighten Automaton + Enhance Autosofts* on each twin in combat (swapping to *Attack/Sleaze Attribution* + *Diffusion [FW]* or *Resonance Wires* out of combat). |
| **6** | **Transcendent Network** | *H&S* p. 69 *(Prereq: Living Network)* | **9K*** | **SRM #4** *(M2, L7)* | Shared Edge pool (`= Grade`) + bonus Minor Action on *Send Message* (*SRMG* M-TOC rules). *(End M2: L7 $\rightarrow$ L6.)* |
| **7** | **Software Emulator** | *H&S* p. 69 *(Prereq: Living Network)* | **11K*** | **SRM #5** *(M3, L6)* | **Requires `RES 6 -> 7` (`35K`) first.** Optional passive/rigger slots (`Personal Assistant`, `Directional Shield`, `Smartsoft`, `Swarm`—no need for a hacking program library; swap behind `Sprite Link` if unneeded). |
| **8** | **Sprite Link** | *H&S* p. 69 | **12K*** | **SRM #6** *(M3, L6)* | **Requires `RES 7 -> 8` (`40K`) first.** `+1` bonus Minor Action when commanding sprite Teamwork; fading transfer. *(End M3: L6 $\rightarrow$ L5.)* |
| **9** | **Syntax Error** | *H&S* p. 69 | **14K*** | **SRM #7** *(M4, L5)* | **Requires `RES 8 -> 9` (`45K`) first.** Anytime defense (`+Grade` dice) & unravels sustained CFs/sprite powers. |

### Tracker 3: Nuyen & DIY Hardware Queue (Minor Actions)

*Every hull mod doubles across the twin Silverstars (`8 Chassis / 8 Powertrain / 8 Electronics` base slots + `2` Standard Hardpoints each; `Wheeled` uses `2` Powertrain slots, `Passive Stealth` uses `1` Electronics slot). Drone modifications use **50% DIY workshop pricing** (*Double Clutch*, p. 120), install incrementally by paying rating differences, and fit up to 3 drones per Minor Action. **Why `Body` crushes `Standard Armor`:** drones share **one Condition Monitor** (no Stun overflow buffer), soak with `Body`, ignore non-electrical Stun `<= Body` (*CRB* p. 197), and lose `10` Top Speed per `+1` `Standard Armor` (*DC* pp. 132–133).*
